officialText:
It shall be the duty of an applicant for construction document approval to determine whether the site of the proposed work is part of a covered development project and to disclose such information on construction documents. Failure to disclose such information on construction documents shall be a violation of this code.

(L.L. 2017/097, 5/30/2017, eff. 6/1/2019; Am. L.L. 2020/091, 9/27/2020, eff. 3/26/2021)

Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2020/091.
